Terms and Conditions of Storage
Harbourline Self Storage Ltd, effective from 1 November 2026

These terms apply to every storage agreement between Harbourline Self Storage Ltd and its customers. Please read them carefully, in particular clauses 7 and 9, which limit our liability and allow us to sell goods if charges remain unpaid.
1. Definitions
In these terms the following words have the meanings given below.

Agreementthe storage agreement signed by the Customer, together with these termsAccess Hoursthe hours displayed at the Store during which the Customer may enter itCustomerthe person or business named in the AgreementGoodseverything kept in the Unit, including packagingStorethe self storage building in which the Unit is locatedUnitthe storage space allocated to the Customer
2. The Agreement
2.1 The Agreement starts on the date shown in it and continues for at least the minimum period of four weeks.
2.2 After the minimum period the Agreement continues from week to week until ended under clause 8.
2.3 The Customer confirms that the details given to us are true and will tell us promptly of any change of address, telephone number or e-mail address.
3. Use of the Unit
3.1 The Unit may be used only for storing Goods. It must not be used as an office, a workshop or living accommodation.
3.2 The Customer must not store:
(a) food or anything else that attracts vermin;
(b) living animals or plants;
(c) hazardous items, including:
(i) flammable liquids, gas cylinders or fireworks;
(ii) chemicals, asbestos or other toxic material;
(d) cash, securities or items of special value such as jewellery or works of art.
3.3 The Customer must keep the Unit locked with a padlock of their own choice and must not give the key to anyone not named in the Agreement.
4. Charges and Payment
4.1 Storage charges are payable four weeks in advance, on the start date and on every fourth week after it.
4.2 Payment is made by card or direct debit. We do not accept cash at the Store.
4.3 We may change the charges by giving at least 28 days notice in writing.
4.4 A fee of 15 pounds is added to any payment that is more than 7 days late.
5. Access

The Customer may enter the Store during Access Hours using the personal code issued to them. We may close the Store, or limit access to it, for maintenance or in an emergency, and will give as much notice as we reasonably can. We may also enter the Unit without notice if we believe it is needed to prevent damage to the Store or to other units, or if the police or another authority require it.
6. Insurance

The Goods are stored at the Customer's own risk and are not insured by us. The Customer must either insure the Goods for their full replacement value or join the cover scheme offered at the Store. The value declared in the Agreement is the maximum value of the Goods for all purposes.
7. Liability
7.1 We are not liable for loss of or damage to the Goods unless it is caused by our negligence or deliberate act.
7.2 Our total liability under the Agreement is limited to 1,000 pounds, except for death or personal injury caused by our negligence, for which liability is not limited.
7.3 The Customer is responsible for any damage caused to the Store, to other units or to any person by the Goods or by the Customer's use of the Unit.
8. Ending the Agreement

Either party may end the Agreement after the minimum period by giving at least 14 days notice. On the last day the Customer must remove all Goods, leave the Unit clean and empty, and remove their padlock. Charges already paid for a period after the end date are refunded within 30 days.
9. Unpaid Charges and Sale of Goods
9.1 If charges are unpaid for 14 days, we may refuse access to the Unit and over-lock it.

10. General

Our store team can explain any of these terms before you sign. Ask at the front desk or call 0117 496 0412.
